snippet.title: FleshFarm- Official Gameplay Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Flesh Farm is a third-person shooter inspired by 90s horror classics. Battle through a cult-run farm to find your missing wife and son. Hack with an axe, shred with a chainsaw and blast enemies with a shotgun. Solve puzzles, collect body parts, and uncover dark hidden secrets in the compound.

Flesh Farm releases in October 2025. Wishlist now on STEAM!
